name: Run isolation
responsibility: One run's private world: its own home, its own agent storage, its own CLI on the path
description: The run's vault is .archboard/vault in its Flask checkout, made after the clone because a clone needs an empty destination. The run's environment names no vault: every command finds it from the checkout it runs in (ADR 0049). Git looks no higher than the run's directory, and that directory links .archboard/vault to the run's vault, so a command anywhere in the world finds the run's vault and never the vault of the archboard checkout that holds the batch.
